description: This file defines request handlers for session management in a gateway server, including creating, listing, updating, deleting, and managing session messages and transcripts.

methods.name: requireSessionKey
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a session key, responding with an error if invalid.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySessionTargetFromKey
methods.description: Resolves configuration and store path for a given session key.

methods.name: resolveOptionalInitialSessionMessage
methods.description: Determines initial session message from parameters.

methods.name: shouldAttachPendingMessageSeq
methods.description: Checks if a pending message sequence should be attached based on payload status.

methods.name: emitSessionsChanged
methods.description: Broadcasts session change events to subscribers.

methods.name: rejectWebchatSessionMutation
methods.description: Prevents webchat clients from mutating sessions directly.

methods.name: buildDashboardSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a dashboard session key for an agent.

methods.name: ensureSessionTranscriptFile
methods.description: Ensures the session transcript file exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveAbortSessionKey
methods.description: Determines the session key to abort, considering active runs.

methods.name: hasTrackedActiveSessionRun
methods.description: Checks if there is an active tracked session run.

methods.name: interruptSessionRunIfActive
methods.description: Attempts to interrupt an active session run or embedded Pi run.

methods.name: handleSessionSend
methods.description: Handles sending or steering a session message, including interruption logic.
